title: home-app: the merge tool finds its checks, and a skipped draft run is restarted the right way
why: home-app session report, Oct 25 (PR 271): the PR's own checks had skipped, so it pushed an empty commit (345ff43) to start a run; and the merge tool stopped because home-app's main has no branch protection, so it found no required checks.
note: Ruling, Oct 26 (shiv, page item 16, a): roll out one visit per repo, after o2's layout move, with c42 first; before each visit, warn you which sessions in that repo to pause. c42 is the first visit; it waits on o2. Checked Oct 25 at home-app 65315da. Cause 1: home-app test.yml skips the scope job, and so every job, on a draft PR (home-app rule: drafts run no CI). The manual workflow_dispatch run that passed does not count as the PR's checks. Marking the PR ready (ready_for_review is a trigger) starts a real run on the same head, with no new commit. Cause 2: merge.py reads required checks from .github/stamp.json merge.requiredChecks first and only falls back to branch protection; home-app has no stamp.json. The tool's own stop message names the fix. Advisor pick: fix in home-app (stamp.json plus one CLAUDE.md line); branch protection on home-app main is optional and needs your login. Same fix fits banchi and q_max if they lack stamp.json (not checked). Related: c33 (home has no CI at all). Update Oct 28: home-app merged into shivinate7/home on Oct 26, and home's roll-out visit merged (c163, home#370); o2's half merged in batch 7. Next cloud lane, read-only, in home: does home have .github/stamp.json and the draft-skip in its CI; report, change nothing. A fix lands in home only on your word (waiting page). Placed ahead of r1 (triage 10, Oct 28): first roll-out visit. Doing: read-only lane 013NEJL23Qu2, Oct 28.
ask:
Brief for a home-app session (paste all of it):

Goal: the claude-settings merge tool runs in home-app, and a PR whose draft run skipped gets a real run without an empty commit.
1. Add .github/stamp.json with merge.requiredChecks naming the jobs in .github/workflows/test.yml: scope, test, addon, ios. Copy the shape from claude-settings .github/stamp.json. Set merge.deadlineMinutes to the largest job timeout-minutes plus 5. The merge tool already passes a skipped job, and goes red only when no job ran on the head (merge/merge.py judge_runs).
2. Proof: run the merge tool's dry read on an open PR (or the next one) and show it lists the four checks instead of stopping on "no branch protection".
3. Add one line to home-app CLAUDE.md's CI rule: when a PR's run skipped because it was a draft, mark it ready (gh pr ready), which starts the PR run on the same head; never push an empty commit to start CI.
Report: Done, Deviations, Input Needed, Next.
